VALUABLE REAL ESTATE FOR SALE.—By the
last will of James Webb, decd. we are Direct
ed to sell the following tracts OF land, THE
first which lies in the county of King and Queen, upon the
stage road between Richmond and Tappahannock about
thirty two miles from the former place, and three
miles from the place known by the name of Dunkirk,
upon the Matapony river, TO which place said river is
navigable for large boats and lighters. This contains
nearly a thousand acres, large portion of which may
be considered fertile and considerable part of it very
well timbered. The situation is very healthy and agreeable,
and the land has a large and handsome
dwelling house in good repair and it has besides abundance
OF other buildings which are in good repair. THE
second which lies in Essex county, the south
side of Piscataway Creek, about five miles below Tap
pahannock, and upon the road leading from Tappahannock
to Urbanna in Middlesex county. This has upon
it no buildings Of any value, the dwelling house having
burnt some years past but likewise considered healthy
and it well timbered with the best white oak and from the
site OF the ancient dwelling house there is a good view of
the Rappahannock river. The Piscataway Creek which
is the boundary OF the tract to the North is navigable for
large vessels quite up the road from Tappahannock. THE
third tract, to wit that upon which Mr. Anthony Haynes
resides lying in Essex county, about ten miles below Tap
pahannock, Immediately upon the Rappahannock river.
This tract contains upwards of four hundred acres and is very
healthy and FERTILE and has upon it a dwelling house OF
convenient size which, with a small expenditure, may be
made very comfortable and desirable with other
buildings necessary for the plantation. Being required by
the will OF Testator TO sell the said lands privately, we
invite and solicit all persons who may be disposed to
purchase the lands and make such propositions. The first
tract will be shewn by Mr. Thomas Smith who lives upon
it, the second by Doctor William Smith, who lives with
Mr. Anthony Haynes, and the third by Mr. Anthony Haynes
himself. ALEXANDER FLEET


JAMES SMITH,


Executors Of James Webb, decd.
